data_availability_text: Data availabilityWe made our summary statistics and individual-level proteomic data publicly available (https://zenodo.org/records/14213102)66. Furthermore, we developed an online tool that enables researchers to explore the machine learning model and use it with their own Olink data (https://ndru-ndrs-lng-nih.shinyapps.io/web_server_shiny/). The pQTL data from the UK Biobank used for Mendelian randomization are available at https://www.synapse.org/Synapse:syn51365301, and the ALS GWAS data are available at https://gwas.mrcieu.ac.uk/datasets/ebi-a-GCST90027163/. The Olink data from the UK Biobank can be obtained via controlled access on their web portal (https://www.ukbiobank.ac.uk/).
